elaine: Quick sync — proposal for a deferred deploy pattern for ModelSwitch v2. Plan: staged canary (EU -> US) + short A/B microtests, then regionwide rollout with automatic fallback on metric regressions. Putting the draft below, please flag gaps.

marcus: +1 to staged EU->US. What's our exact metric gate set?

elaine: thinking: p50 latency delta <= +25ms, p95 <= +60ms, error rate delta <= +0.3%, quality evals show no regressions on the 2000-sample prompt set. Also require no customer-facing 5xx for 30m.

tina: suggest adding token-cost guardrail for hosted tier — if avg tokens/sec cost rises > 10% revert. We saw cost surprises last rollout.

ben: agree. Also recommend a shadow route to dedicated infra for 5% of traffic to validate KV-cache behavior under load before canary.

elaine: good call. So flow: 1) deploy canary code with flag ff.model_v2_shadow=true (shadow 5%) 2) run 4h smoke with shadow telemetry 3) enable canary (2% traffic EU) for 1h ramp, metric check 4) if green, bump to 10% EU for 2h 5) cross-region small slice US (1%) then ramp.

amanda: operational checklist: add temporary alert rule `canary:model_v2:regression` with 3m evaluation, hook to #eng-oncall and create a transient runbook link. Who owns the runbook?

ops-bot: Deployment bot: scheduled window reserved 2026-04-02T02:00Z for canary. Add /deploy --canary=eu-2pct --flag=ff.model_v2 to confirm.

marcus: runbook owner: tina + marcus for ops handoff. I'll draft the rollback steps: immediate flag flip to ff.model_v2=false, then rollback traffic routing to previous model variant, then hotfix branch.

tina: A/B microtests: expose new sampling to 5% of new users in EU for 6h to collect behavioral metrics (prompt completion quality + downstream conversion). Keep sample size target >= 10k requests.

elaine: telemetry specifics: use these dashboards — p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, cost-per-1k-tokens, eval-regression delta, and prompt-quality drift (BLEU/ROUGE-ish analog + manual QA notes). Thresholds: fail if any one threshold tripped for 3 consecutive eval windows (15m each).

ben: fallback policies: immediate fallback to model_v1 for affected region; secondary fallback: route to lower-capacity quantized variant if v1 not available. Make sure cache warmup is acceptable.

amanda: legal/security: ensure no private-customer traffic is included in A/B sample for Private deployments; feature flags must respect tenancy tagging. Also add a telemetry mask for PII.

marcus: ops note — during canary, we'll throttle batch sizes to limit memory pressure: max_batch=8 for canary nodes. Update autoscaler profile to hold min_nodes=2.

elaine: I'll update the rollout doc and add a short checklist: code branch, flag keys, canary slices, metric gates, runbook link, rollback steps, legal checklist, ops knobs. ETA for doc update: EOD today.

tina: thumbs up. One more ask: include a short-scale chaos test (kill one canary pod) once at 10% to verify graceful fallback. Schedule in the ramp.

elaine: noted. I'll add `chaos:pod_kill=true` as a conditional step after 10% phase and ensure oncall knows.

amanda: ok from security side. Please ping me before the shadow run.

marcus: I'll draft the A/B metric sheet and post it here in the morning.

elaine: thanks all — I'll post the canonical rollout checklist and the feature flag names here when done. :rocket:
